traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements in docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are fully implemented and verified: - Core Functionality & Plugin Structure: src/index.ts exports a standard ESLint plugin object with rules and configs, uses a centralized rule registry, and attaches meta (name, namespace, version). Tests plugin-setup.test.ts and plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts (explicitly linked to this story) all pass in the latest Jest run. - Quality Standards & Metadata: The plugin exposes meta consistent with package.json, follows ESLint plugin conventions, and is documented in docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md and docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md. - Integration with ESLint v9 Flat Config: configs.recommended and configs.strict are flat-config compatible and verified via tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts, which shows that the presets work when consumed by FlatESLint. - User Experience: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provide clear installation and configuration instructions for using the plugin with ESLint 9, matching the story’s UX criteria. - Error Handling: Rule loading errors are caught and surfaced via placeholder rules and console logging, tested thoroughly in plugin-setup-error.test.ts and cli-error-handling.test.ts, and the plugin behaves correctly when rules are missing or misconfigured. - Documentation & Test Setup: Internal developer docs exist and are up to date, and the Jest-based test infrastructure (with TypeScript tooling) validates the plugin’s behavior. All relevant suites were just re-run with `npm test -- --ci --no-watch --runInBand --verbose` and passed.
Based on this concrete evidence, the story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented and validated, so the status is PASSED.
